2608.13547.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
2608.13547.paper_summary: LLM coding agents issue Bash commands through interfaces that may serialize, wrap, and reparse model output. Matched execution scores alone cannot distinguish command-generation errors from failures introduced after generation. QuoteBench measures this boundary with exact final-state validation on 56 one-shot tasks from 14 incident-derived families, crossing the generation contract with the execution transport around one deliberately unescaped added parser. Escaping at the interpolation point reproduces each replayed reply's raw-path outcome, so any recovery under a disclosed boundary must come from the model changing its generation. Across eight same-window configurations, replaying the same reply through the added parser lowers success by 55.4 to 73.2 percentage points; disclosure recovers 30.4 to 60.7 points for six configurations, and zero or slightly negative for the other two. Raw generation is nearly saturated at the frontier; boundary adaptation is what still separates models. GPT-5.6-sol's matched gap of -3.6 points hides -64.3 points of damage and +60.7 points of compensation. The deployment configuration reorders models: one reversal among 26 comparable pairs is unambiguous and four more sit on single-task margins. Evaluations of command-issuing agents should report the model configuration, generation contract, execution path, operating point, and final-state validator rather than treat a matched score as an intrinsic model property.
2608.13547.paper_summary_zh: LLM 編碼代理透過介面發出 Bash 命令，這些介面可能會序列化、包裝和重新解析模型輸出。僅僅依賴匹配的執行分數無法區分命令生成錯誤與生成後引入的失敗。QuoteBench 透過對 14 個事件衍生家族中的 56 個一次性任務進行精確的最終狀態驗證來測量這一邊界，將生成合約與執行傳輸交叉，圍繞一個故意未轉義的新增解析器。 在插值點的轉義再現了每個重播回覆的原始路徑結果，因此在公開邊界下的任何恢復必須來自模型改變其生成。在八種相同窗口配置中，通過新增解析器重播相同回覆使成功率降低了 55.4 到 73.2 個百分點；對於六種配置，公開恢復了 30.4 到 60.7 個點，而另外兩種則為零或略微負數。原始生成在邊界處幾乎飽和；邊界適應仍然是區分模型的關鍵。GPT-5.6-sol 的匹配差距為 -3.6 點隱藏了 -64.3 點的損害和 +60.7 點的補償。部署配置重新排序模型：在 26 對可比的配對中，有一個反轉是明確的，還有四個位於單任務邊緣。對命令發出代理的評估應報告模型配置、生成合約、執行路徑、操作點和最終狀態驗證器，而不是將匹配分數視為內在的模型屬性。
